name: siblings-collage
prompt: Create a spectacular polished editorial promotional hero collage for a bespoke children's morning routine app. Landscape 3:2. Use the supplied four EXISTING sibling sticker pairs as compositing inserts, preserve their specific faces, outfits, clay textures and clean white die-cut outlines. These are the same two children repeated in different routine poses, not eight distinct children. NO TEXT whatsoever, no browser chrome, no cards, no screenshot frames. Art direction: oversized tactile stickers loosely tossed onto pale butter-yellow matte paper with a blush pink wash bottom right. The basketball siblings pair is the largest foreground hero slightly right of center tilted -9 degrees; dressing pair at upper left tilted +12 degrees; toothbrush pair tucked behind at upper right tilted +15 degrees; helmet-and-lunchbox pair at lower left tilted -12 degrees. Layer and overlap sticker edges boldly with soft realistic cast shadows, never obscure faces. Let a few outer feet/sticker edges bleed off canvas for editorial crop energy. Fill the composition with beautiful character detail; no tiny objects or excessive empty space. A few small pink paper hearts and blue doodle-like starbursts in gaps, restrained. High-end playful magazine art direction, asymmetrical but balanced, warm and charming, exceptionally crisp.

name: breakfast-detail
prompt: Create a beautifully art-directed promotional detail composition for an Icelandic children's breakfast routine app. Landscape 3:2. Use the supplied Cheerios and cheese-and-jam toast stickers as compositing inserts preserving packaging, textures, shape and white die-cut outline. Macro scale: two oversized slightly rotated floating food choices dominate the whole canvas, cereal left (-8 degrees) and toast right (+9 degrees), on warm pale cream with subtle buttery yellow and apricot color fields. Suggest a cropped app detail with just a thin pale-yellow time pill at top left reading exactly '07:10', small dark olive heading beside it exactly 'Morgunmatur'. Between foods small 'eða'. Below each food a beautifully minimal floating choice control: cereal has a tiny basketball glyph on a pale blue selected pill with checkmark, toast a pink heart on pale pink selected pill with checkmark. No other text. Food cutouts overlap controls slightly; layer them with gorgeous soft ambient shadows. NO browser frame, NO enclosing cards, NO device mockup, NO big marketing headline. Close and tactile, sparse precise UI fragments with enormous prominent food sticker detail. Editorial product launch image, polished, delicious jam detail and matte clay cereal, balanced intentional negative space.

name: rewards-detail
prompt: Landscape 3:2 promotional product detail collage. Use the supplied smiling yellow star and miniature pink ice cream shop sticker designs, preserving their clay textures and white die-cut edges. Huge ice cream shop right of center tilted 8 degrees, overlapping three yellow stars at left in different sizes and jaunty rotations. Pink and blue luminous soft glow following the icecream sticker outline. Behind the stars a cropped fragment of a minimalist app award row: two slim pink and blue pastel strips with empty star silhouettes. Pale lilac paper background, beautiful dimensional soft shadows. Bold macro scale, editorial tight crop with some outer sticker edges extending beyond canvas. No text, no frames, no people. Polished, sweet and playful.
